meta.name: ai-avatar-video
meta.description: Create AI avatar and talking head videos via inference.sh CLI. Recommended: P-Video-Avatar (fastest, cheapest, built-in TTS). Also: OmniHuman, Fabric, PixVerse. Audio: Inworld TTS-2 (100+ languages, emotion steering for characters), ElevenLabs, Kokoro. Capabilities: audio-driven avatars, text-to-avatar, lipsync videos, talking head generation, virtual presenters, UGC content. Use for: AI presenters, explainer videos, virtual influencers, dubbing, marketing videos, UGC ads, gaming avatars, NPC dialogue. Triggers: ai avatar, talking head, lipsync, avatar video, virtual presenter, ai spokesperson, audio driven video, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, talking avatar, lip sync, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, ugc, ugc video, ugc ad, avatar ugc

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字或音频变成会说话的数字人出镜视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让虚拟人出镜讲解,却不想真人拍摄
copy.tagline_en: Turn text or audio into a talking-avatar video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a virtual presenter on screen without filming anyone.

howto.what: Claude 会用 belt 命令行调用 inference.sh 上的模型，把你给的一张人像图配上文字脚本或音频，生成口型同步的数字人说话视频；也能先生成人像图、给脚本配音，或把已有视频换语言后重新对口型。
howto.when: 当你要做 AI 数字人、口播/对口型视频，或提到 UGC 广告、虚拟主播等的生成需求时触发；需先装好 belt CLI 并可登录。

say.text: 把这段视频转写、翻译后换成新语言重新对口型

howto.what_en: Claude runs inference.sh models through the belt CLI to turn a portrait image plus a text script or audio file into a lipsynced talking-head video; it can also generate portraits, add speech, or re-lipsync videos in another language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for an AI avatar, talking-head or lipsync video, or mention UGC ads, virtual presenters and similar content. Needs the belt CLI installed and logged in.
